Nothing. The repo holds only `.claude/` (skill files) and an initial commit `b9a3e12 start` [verified: git log]. Everything that matters is in this handover.

## 1 · Status
🟡 No task in progress. Several earlier assistant answers contain **errors** (see §6) that the user may come back to; correct them if asked, don't repeat them.

## 2 · Picture
The user chatted across seven dated sessions (Apr 24 – May 30, 2023) about: a statistics homework problem, Italian cooking, a Costa Rica birding trip, picture-book title ideas, fitness (5K running, coworker soccer, a tennis tournament), a no-code community product ("Dots"), and astronomy/exoplanets. Nothing is pending except open threads in §3. Session timestamps are the bracketed "[Chat session on …]" dates; note the two May 30 sessions are 13:53 (fitness) and 15:35 (astronomy).

## 3 · Next actions (only if the user returns to a thread)
1. Stats problem: if asked again, give the corrected values in §6 (the original answer was wrong).
2. Miwa Nakaya picture-book titles: the assistant's reply was **cut off mid-sentence** (05-08) — never delivered. Offer the 30 titles.
3. Astronomy: assistant's last question (international framework/treaty for astrobiology ethics?) was never answered by the user.
4. Tennis "May 6th" date conflict (§9) — clarify before giving any timeline advice.

## 5 · Working with the user
**About the user** [all user said, 2023 dates]:
- Loves Italian food; had an "amazing" Spaghetti Carbonara at **Bella Vita** restaurant; made fettuccine with arrabbiata sauce "last Thursday" (said Thu Apr 27 → ≈ Apr 20, 2023). Chose to make **Spaghetti alla Bolognese** (first meat sauce from scratch), with **80/20** ground beef; will make garlic bread with **Parmesan added to the garlic butter**, timed to come out as pasta is served. Wants to make fresh pasta from scratch soon.
- Birder: planning a **Costa Rica** trip, target **Resplendent Quetzal**. Practises with a **portable hide** at home — stayed in it **3+ hours** without getting restless. Shoots with a **Nikon** camera; wants birds-in-flight. Plans to contact **Tropical Birding Tours** about accommodation (had seen mixed reviews on it) and a customized Quetzal-focused itinerary.
- Picture books: asked for 30 title ideas each "inspired by" Shinsuke Yoshitake, Keiko Sena, Miwa Nakaya, Tatsuya Miyanishi (Japanese picture-book authors) — likely writing/brainstorming picture books.
- Fitness: plays **recreational soccer with coworkers every two weeks**; next game "in two weeks" from May 23 → ≈ **June 6, 2023** (user unsure; recalled a teammate saying it). Recently **scored a goal** (not usually a scorer). Has been strengthening core and legs.
- Running: charity 5K personal best **27:12** (said May 23) → by May 30 states PB is **25:50** and is training for **another charity 5K** to beat it. Current PB = 25:50 (27:12 superseded).
- Tennis: casual player for a few years; **first real tournament on "May 6th"**; goal: at least the **quarterfinals**; practising serve and volleys, then focused on **toss consistency**.
- Works on/markets "**Dots**": no-code flow builder for communities ("like Zapier but for communities"), onboarding flows; interested in a **spatial canvas** as the main no-code UI. Writing style: brief, typos ("benifits", "solutiion").
- Astronomy: learning via **Crash Course** videos; follows **NASA** and **TED-Ed** on Instagram; most interested in **exoplanets / life beyond Earth**, esp. **K2-18b**.
- **User's own view** (05-30): finding life would be a "game-changer"; the most significant challenge is **managing the risks of contact/communication** with a possibly more advanced civilization — careful what info we share, avoid provoking hostility, avoid contaminating their ecosystem; need protocols.

**Taste** (no explicit corrections were made; inferred from behaviour) [assumed]:
- User asks short follow-ups and builds on prior answers ("based on above") — keep continuity with what was said before.
- User repeats questions (5K endurance asked twice on May 30; tennis asked in both fitness sessions) — answer consistently with earlier numbers/plans in §6b.

## 6 · Evidence ledger (errors in earlier answers)
| Claim made earlier | Status | Correct |
|---|---|---|
| Stats: median 136.25, Q1 127.67, Q3 134, D3 131.67, P98 128.33 | **wrong** (misused U-values, inconsistent formulas; P98 < median is impossible) | Classes X = 80–100,100–120,120–140,140–160,160–180 (U×20+130 as midpoints, width 20); f 7,50,80,60,3; cf 7,57,137,197,200. Median = 120+(100−57)/80·20 = **130.75**; Q1 = 100+(50−7)/50·20 = **117.2**; Q3 = 140+(150−137)/60·20 = **144.33**; D3 = 120+(60−57)/80·20 = **120.75**; P98 = 140+(196−137)/60·20 = **159.67** [verified: hand calculation] |
| "Slaty-backed Quetzal (P. costaricensis)" in Costa Rica | wrong — not a real species; only Resplendent Quetzal occurs there | |
| Tropical Birding Tours accommodation tiers & prices ($60–600/night), "Quetzal-focused tours" | **fabricated / unverified** — tell user to confirm with TBT directly | |
| K2-18b "mass about twice Earth", "similar to rocky planets" | wrong — ~8.6 Earth masses, ~2.6 R⊕, likely sub-Neptune | |
| "Mars 2020 rover found seasonal water (2020)"; Europa Clipper/Terrestrial Planet Finder will observe K2-18b | wrong/unsupported | |
| Keiko Sena bio (born 1932, "Where is the Cake?") | doubtful [assumed wrong]; "Where Is the Cake?" is by Thé Tjong-Khing | |
| "Didn't know Miwa Nakaya" | Nakaya Miwa is a Japanese picture-book author (e.g. Kureyon no Kuro-kun) [assumed, not checked] | |
| Garlic bread: "Grissini" listed as a loaf | wrong (breadsticks) — minor | |

## 6b · What I told the user (they may ask again)
- Bolognese recipe: 1 lb ground beef, onion, 2 garlic cloves, carrot, celery, 28 oz crushed tomatoes, 1 cup red wine, 1 cup beef broth, 1 tbsp tomato paste, 1 tsp basil, 1 tsp oregano; simmer 2–3 h; 1 lb spaghetti. Wines: Chianti, Barbera, Valpolicella, Sangiovese; whites Pinot Grigio/Vermentino.
- Garlic bread: 2–3 cloves + ½ stick butter, 350°F/180°C, 10–12 min, 1-inch slices, optional 1–2 min broil.
- Fresh pasta: "00" flour; simple dough 1 cup flour, 1 egg, ¼ tsp salt, water as needed, knead 10–15 min, rest 30 min, cook 2–4 min. Resources: Marcella Hazan *Essentials of Classic Italian Cooking*, Pasta Grannies (YouTube), The Kitchn, Jamie Oliver; machines Marcato Atlas 150, KitchenAid roller attachment.
- Quetzal spots: Monteverde, Los Quetzales NP, Savegre Valley, Talamanca; dry season Dec–Apr, early morning, fruiting aguacatillo trees, hire local guide. Operators listed: Tropical Birding, Birdquest, Venture Birding, "Costa Rica Birding", "Birding Costa Rica" (last ones unverified).
- Nikon lenses: 80-400mm f/4.5-5.6G, 200-500mm f/5.6E, 500mm f/4E; ≥1/1000 s, AF-C, burst. Apps: Merlin, iBird Pro, eBird, Xeno-canto; guide *Birds of Costa Rica* (Garrigues & Dean).
- 5K plan (May 30): Mon 30-min easy · Tue intervals 4–6×800 m at 3:20–3:40 with 400 m jog · Wed rest · Thu 30-min easy · Fri strength · Sat 6–8 km long run · Sun rest/active recovery; +10–15% weekly mileage.
- Tennis: serve tips, 5 toss drills (toss-and-catch, toss-and-hold, toss-and-move, toss-and-visualize, partner toss); racket/string guidance.
- Picture-book lists: 30 titles each for Yoshitake (e.g. "The Great Sock Mystery"), Keiko Sena (e.g. "Momo the Mole and the Underground World"), Miyanishi (dinosaur-themed, e.g. "The Tiny Titanosaur's Big Dream"). Nakaya list not delivered.
- Dots: described Spatial Canvas as visual drag-and-drop flow builder; goals: automate onboarding, personalized content routing, moderation flagging, visual flow debugging.

## 9 · Gotchas
- **Tennis date**: "May 6th" was said on May 23 and May 30, 2023 as *upcoming*, but May 6 had already passed (and the user was asking about Costa Rica that day). Ask whether it's next year / a different date; don't assume.
- **5K PB**: 25:50 is current (May 30); 27:12 (May 23) is superseded. Both answers on May 30 targeted "under 25:50".
- Soccer date is approximate (user not sure).
